findings.title: FTP server allows anonymous login
findings.evidence: logged in as "anonymous", server replied 230 Login successful.
findings.fix: Disable anonymous FTP unless you really mean to share files publicly. For vsftpd set anonymous_enable=NO.

findings.title: Unencrypted Telnet server
findings.evidence: (Nmap's name for the Telnet server changes between runs)
findings.fix: Turn off Telnet and use SSH instead. Telnet sends passwords as plain text, so anyone on the network can read them.

findings.title: Web server is missing security headers
findings.evidence: GET http://127.0.0.1:18080/ returned 200 without these headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options
findings.fix: Configure the web server to send the missing headers. Most servers can add them in one line of config.
